svg.title: 훈민정음 — modern Hangul brush lettering
svg.desc: Exact modern Hangul title in Nanum Brush Script. Font outlines are fixed paths, with no runtime font dependency. Original paper artwork, not a facsimile. The small red ornament is abstract and contains no text.
svg.metadata: Font: Nanum Brush Script, Copyright 2010 NHN Corporation, Sandoll Communications Inc.; SIL OFL 1.1. Source: https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/nanumbrushscript
